name: Coffee Shop Creator
tagline: Laptop, latte and a corner table: work-from-café content.
description: For freelancers, writers and creators who live in cafés: laptop corner tables, journaling, filming at the table, pour-over rituals, video calls, sketching, photo editing and rainy-day focus sessions. Warm, productive and relatable.
